statements.title: Mr. MASSIE. Mr. Speaker, I rise to raise a question of the privileges of the House and offer a resolution previously noticed.
statements.displayText: I rise to raise a question of the privileges of the House and offer a resolution previously noticed.

statements.title: Mr. MASSIE. Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to this clean reauthorization of an unconstitutional program that is being used to spy on Americans without warrants.
statements.displayText: I rise in opposition to this clean reauthorization of an unconstitutional program that is being used to spy on Americans without warrants.

statements.title: Congress has voted for ten bills now that will put US citizens at risk, prolong the conflict in Ukraine, waste tax-payer money, increase domestic food and energy prices, and draw us further into this conflict. I have voted against all of them.
statements.displayText: Congress has voted for ten bills now that will put US citizens at risk, prolong the conflict in Ukraine, waste tax-payer money, increase domestic food and energy prices, and draw us further into this conflict. I have voted against all of them.

statements.title: I knew all along they would trade the cow for magic beans. These beans are like the rest. They don't sprout.
